text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm in my office doing paperwork when…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… Trainer, I need your help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My head is pounding… I can't think straight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're my assistant. You have to do something about this pain…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aaah… It even hurts just to speak. There's no way I can do proper research like this…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I can't even make any painkillers. Sigh… It's hopeless…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon looks terrible. I should do something to help her.
